items.heading: How do I enroll a student?
items.body: Select Enroll student, enter their name and email, choose a program, and confirm. New records appear in the student directory for this session.

items.heading: How do I export campus records?
items.body: Open Reports and choose a CSV download. Student search and status filters also apply to the directory export.

items.heading: About this workspace
items.body: This is a sample campus workspace. All people are fictional and records are held in memory for this session.
